t: 英国历史上记录到的最大地震之一,佛兰德斯或法国北部也发生.
te: One of the largest earthquakes recorded in the history of England, Flanders, or Northern France, takes place.
dz: 英国历史上记录到的最大地震之一,佛兰德斯或法国北部也发生.
de: One of the largest earthquakes recorded in the history of England, Flanders, or Northern France, takes place.

t: 奥斯特罗格圣经是早期以斯拉夫语印刷的圣经之一,出版.
te: The Ostrog Bible, one of the early printed Bibles in a Slavic language, is published.
dz: 奥斯特罗格圣经是早期以斯拉夫语印刷的圣经之一,出版.
de: The Ostrog Bible, one of the early printed Bibles in a Slavic language, is published.

t: 西班牙在阿尔坎塔拉战役的胜利带来了伊比利亚联盟.
te: Spanish victory at the Battle of Alcântara brings about the Iberian Union.
dz: 葡萄牙继承之战:西班牙在阿尔坎塔拉战役的胜利带来了伊比利亚联盟.
de: War of the Portuguese Succession: Spanish victory at the Battle of Alcântara brings about the Iberian Union.

t: 弗朗西斯·德雷克 (Francis Drake) 在英国普利茅斯完成了他的环球航行。
te: Francis Drake finishes his circumnavigation of the Earth in Plymouth, England.
dz: 弗朗西斯·德雷克 (Francis Drake) 在英国普利茅斯完成了他的环球航行。
de: Francis Drake finishes his circumnavigation of the Earth in Plymouth, England.

t: 超过600名教皇出兵在爱尔兰登陆,支持第二次德斯蒙德叛乱.
te: Over 600 Papal troops land in Ireland to support the Second Desmond Rebellion.
dz: 超过600名教皇出兵在爱尔兰登陆,支持第二次德斯蒙德叛乱.
de: Over 600 Papal troops land in Ireland to support the Second Desmond Rebellion.

dz: 第二次德斯蒙德叛乱:斯默威克之围以天主教守军向阿瑟·格雷手下的英军投降而结束. 大部分驻军于次日被屠杀.
de: Second Desmond Rebellion: The Siege of Smerwick ends with the Catholic garrison surrendering to the English forces under Arthur Grey. The majority of the garrison is massacred the next day.
